subject: Request: Reactivate lapsed trial & retroactive promotional credit
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Patel <lina@courier.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Hi Olga,

We were experimenting with Redwood during June/July and had a short pilot running under the promotional code you provided. Our engineering lead left unexpectedly and we let the sandbox lapse — the account now shows as inactive and the trial credits have expired. We have an active POC with milestones next week and losing access is blocking evaluation.

Can Redwood: 1) temporarily reactivate the sandbox so our engineers can finish integration, and 2) apply the promotional credit retroactively so the usage for the POC is covered? I attached a screenshot of the billing page and a CSV with approximate usage timestamps.

We’re on a compressed timeline and would appreciate a quick yes/no so we can plan. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Infrastructure, Courier AI
alex@courier.ai

Attachment: billing-screenshot-aug3.pdf (image/pdf)
Attachment: trial-usage-log.csv (text/csv)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for the attachments, that context helps.

Short answer: we can usually offer a brief sandbox reactivation and consider a retroactive promo credit on a case-by-case basis for active POCs. Before I move this to approvals, two quick asks so we can expedite:

- Confirm the HubSpot deal id (or the email the trial was created under) — I pulled a record that looks like COURIER-347 but want to be sure.
- Confirm the minimum runway you need (e.g., 48 hours, 7 days).
- Any regulatory constraints (data region) — I see you were provisioned in us-west.

I'll loop in Ben (CS) to verify the technical reactivation steps and Kim (finance) for the retro credit. If you can confirm the few items above, I’ll request a temporary 7-day sandbox reactivation and flag a retro credit proposal for approval.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Alex / Olga — I checked the sandbox record. We can restore access quickly; technical impact is minimal. Reprovisioning will restore the API key and the KV cache will be cold — recommend engineers warm the common prompts.

I can re-enable the sandbox for 7 days now if the account owner authorizes. We’ll also put a note on the account to avoid automated cleanup for that period. No config changes required on your side.

Can you confirm the email used to create the trial (so I un-suspend the correct account)?

Ben
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Thanks for the loop, team. From Finance: we can approve a retroactive promotional credit up to $2,500 for POCs where there is a clear path to purchase, provided sales documents indicate active engagement. If Courier AI needs more than that for the next 7 days, we’ll need a brief note from sales indicating expected ARR or next procurement step — that can be a short email.

If approved, allocation will be posted as a one-time credit and will show on the next billing cycle; it cannot be used to offset past invoices already closed. I see the usage is recent and should be eligible.

Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Alex — looping back with the approval path. Kim can approve up to $2.5k without escalation. If that is sufficient we’ll: 1) re-enable the sandbox for 7 days (Ben to action immediately), and 2) post a one-time $2,500 credit to your account to cover the POC usage.

If you need a larger bridge, please reply here with the intended procurement timeline (e.g., RFP in September, committed PO in Q4) or expected ARR, and I’ll prepare a short business note for finance to review an exception.

Do you want me to proceed with the $2.5k option now?

Best,
Olga
From: Alex Turner <alex@courier.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lina Patel <lina@courier.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — can we reactivate and apply promo retroactively?

Thanks, Olga / Kim / Ben — 2.5k will get us across the POC milestone this week. Please proceed with the 7-day reactivation and the $2,500 credit. We’ll follow up with a short note on expected spend and procurement timeline by Friday; current plan is to move to a paid pilot if integration metrics look good.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Infrastructure, Courier AI
alex@courier.ai
